a:r.a:t: Attachment of Ubiquitin to Target Proteins

p:cNvPr.descr: A pathway where ubiquitin is attached to a protein. At the top is ubiquitin in a box, which bonds right to C, which double bonds up and right to O, and bonds down and right to O-. A down arrow is below this. To the right is a curved arrow that tangents. It begins with HS (where S is pink), which bonds right to a long oval labeled as E1 [plus] ATP in an orange oval and points to AMP [plus] PPi. Below this Ubiquitin in a box bonds right to C, which double bonds up to O and right to S (pink), which bonds right to E1 in an oval. This has a down arrow with a curved arrow beginning at HS (where S is pink) bonding to E2 in a blue oval, and pointing to HS (where S is pink) which bonds right to E1 in an oval. This points down to the same ubiquitin formula as above. It has a down arrow with a curved arrow on the right pointing from HS (where S is pink), which bonds right to E2 in an oval to HS (where S is pink), which bonds right to E1 in an oval. Below this is the same ubiquitin formula, but S bonds right to E2. Below this is a down arrow with E3 in an elongated oval on the left, and a curved arrow on the right, which points from H2N, which bonds right to Lys, which bonds right to the target protein in a purple oval to HS (where S is pink) bonding right to E2 in an oval. Below this is ubiquitin in a box, which bonds right to C, which double bonds up to O and bonds right to NH, which bonds right to Lys, which bonds right to target population in a purple oval.
